verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents serving your own fine-tuned weights: 'Deploy Private Models' runs fine-tuned LLMs on dedicated A100–B300 instances with autoscaling and a private endpoint. It also rents GPU clusters 'for training' over SSH. However, there is no managed fine-tuning job or API, so the training half depends on the user running their own training on raw rented hardware. missing for 10: managed fine-tuning service/API for supported base models, documented dataset upload and training workflow, a documented path from training output to deployment, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can fine-tune a supported base model on my own data and serve the result on the same platform

citations.quote: Run your own fine-tuned LLM on A100 / H100 / H200 / B200 / B300 with autoscaling.
